summary: Decreased right pleural and right basilar airspace opacity compared with prior.

findings.rationale: The prior shows a larger veiling right pleural effusion with blunted right base; the current exam shows substantially more visible aerated right lower hemithorax despite minor projection differences.

Beyond the reduced right pleural fluid, the prior right basilar airspace opacity is less dense on the current study with clearer right infrahilar/lower-lung detail; left basilar change is comparatively limited.
